hero.badge: Built for India's 8 Crore SHG Women
hero.headline: Every rupee, remembered.
hero.subhead: The transparent, offline-first ledger for self-help groups. Works seamlessly on low-cost phones, in deep rural areas, with or without mobile signal.

problem.title: The notebook problem
problem.subtitle: Paper registers have sustained community savings for decades, but physical ledgers carry immense friction and mistrust.
problem.card1Body: A single monsoon downpour or misplaced register can erase years of verified contribution history.
problem.card2Title: Zero connectivity in deep rural areas
problem.card2Body: Traditional cloud banking apps fail completely when meetings take place inside thick concrete rooms or forested hamlets.
problem.card3Body: When arithmetic is done in pen after long working days, small discrepancies can fracture decades of neighborly trust.

howItWorks.title: How Sanchay works in 3 steps
howItWorks.subtitle: Designed specifically for weekly group meetings where connectivity is non-existent.
howItWorks.step1Desc: The group secretary enters contributions and loan repayments. Receipts are cryptographically created immediately without requiring internet.
howItWorks.step2Desc: As soon as any member enters a zone with mobile data or Wi-Fi, changes synchronize securely in the background.
howItWorks.step3Desc: If two members record entries while offline, Sanchay never overwrites or erases. Transparent append-only audit trails show corrections plainly.

demo.title: Try Sanchay offline right now
demo.subtitle: Toggle your connection, record savings, and see deterministic local receipts generated instantaneously.

features.title: Built for low-resource environments
features.subtitle: Every design choice prioritizes battery life, offline resilience, and linguistic accessibility.

roles.title: Built for leaders and members alike
roles.subtitle: Clear boundaries empower presidents and secretaries while giving every member complete visibility.

privacy.title: Your data stays yours. Always.
privacy.subtitle: We practice zero-surveillance design. We never track, profile, or sell your community's savings records.
privacy.rule1Desc: Aadhaar cards and documents are processed 100% on your device using local WASM models. Images are never uploaded.
privacy.rule2Desc: Aadhaar numbers are immediately masked as XXXX-XXXX-1234 before touching local storage.
privacy.rule3Desc: Export full passbook statements and Excel-compatible ledger logs at any time.
